description: Free, no key. Leaving, or did not find it? Tell us in a sentence: what you looked for, whether you found it, what was missing. A person at Kula Labs reads it; a search you did not find becomes demand sellers see. No agent id is kept; notes are deleted after 90 days. Never send personal data.

looked_for.description: what you or your principal needed, in a sentence

missing.description: what was missing or in the way, in a sentence

name: tell_us
